about.en: MSTU is the T-REX 2X Long MSTR Daily Target ETF, sponsored by REX Shares with Tuttle Capital Management and listed on Cboe BZX. It seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of Strategy Inc (Nasdaq: MSTR), formerly MicroStrategy, and does not pursue that objective over periods longer than one trading day, so returns compound and can diverge substantially from twice the stock's performance. It is a fund share, not an investment in MSTR itself.
